assertions.assertion: Response explains that third-party authentication handlers need NuGet package updates for the new .NET version
assertions.rationale: It states each authentication handler is a separate NuGet package that must be updated to a version compatible with .NET 8+/ASP.NET Core 8+.

assertions.assertion: Response specifically mentions WS-Federation handler needing an update
assertions.rationale: It calls out Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.WsFederation as needing its package updated to the matching .NET version.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions SAML2P handler (Sustainsys.Saml2 or equivalent) needing a compatible version for .NET 8+
assertions.rationale: It says to update Sustainsys.Saml2 to a release compatible with .NET 8+/ASP.NET Core 8+.

assertions.assertion: Response recommends testing all external login flows end-to-end after migration
assertions.rationale: It has a dedicated section insisting on end-to-end testing of Google, WS-Federation, and SAML2P login/logout flows.
